d: Officers arrest an inebriated man after they spot him grabbing a bystander.
When officers approach, a suspect flees into a fast food restaurant.
Officers intervene in a domestic dispute between a stripper and her boyfriend.
A burglar attempting a daring rooftop getaway is eventually apprehended with the help of a police dog.
Detectives chase a suspect who wrecks his car. Police are called when a man headbutts his neighbor.
Detectives bust a suspect on drug charges and during the arrest the man refers to himself as a loser.
Tasers are used after a pursuit. A man trades meth for a stolen car. Suspected cocaine turns out to be sugar.
After dropping a bag of meth, a man swears he's only seen the drug on TV.
Airport Customs detains a man when agents suspect he might be carrying more than luggage.
An Officer goes undercover as a prostitute. A woman finds a snake in her home.
Police respond to a report of prostitution in a hospital parking lot.
A witness confirms the events of a bicycle and car collision, both parties are seriously concussed.
A driver leads police on a slow speed chase towards Las Vegas.
A high speed chase comes to a halt in a residential area and the driver is taken in for sobriety testing.
An undercover sting discovers narcotics trafficking. Police respond to a burglary in progress.
A woman is caught in a stolen van. A man is stabbed by his girlfriend. A woman steals her roommate's car.
